hypothesis: A mode learned without latent identity must abstain on unprobed actions when a first action gives identical outcomes across distinct previously observed source response modes.

frozen.negative_control: identical source profiles must never produce a claimed physical identity
frozen.source_seeds: deterministic fixed alternation, no task labels visible to learner

strong_controls: train-only unlabeled completed-session response-signature model, set-valued Bayesian-compatible predictive abstention
one pooled trained Beta response predictor
known-latent-identity oracle reported only as unreachable ceiling
required: Zero hard confident incorrect predictions on action 1 after only action-0 observation, and valid prediction when the evidence uniquely identifies a response mode. Source-conditional unknown allowed; no retuning existing implementation.
